Restaurant Policies
General Customer Policy
Customers are expected to maintain respectful behavior toward staff and other guests.
Any abusive language or threatening behavior may result in refusal of service.
Outside food and beverages are not allowed inside the restaurant.
Smoking is prohibited inside dining areas.
Pets are not allowed except certified service animals.
Customers must keep children supervised at all times.
The management reserves the right to refuse service if safety or comfort of guests is compromised.
Lost items are stored for seven days before disposal.
CCTV monitoring is active in all branches for safety purposes.
Customers are encouraged to report any hygiene or service concerns immediately.
Refund and Cancellation Policy
Dine-In Orders
Refunds are only provided if the food is significantly delayed, incorrect, or spoiled.
Refund requests must be made within 15 minutes of receiving the order .
Partial refunds may be offered for missing items.
Online Delivery Orders

Refund requests must be made within 15 minutes of receiving the order .
Partial refunds may be offered for missing items.
Online Delivery Orders
Orders can be canceled within 2 minutes after placement.
Once food preparation begins, cancellation is not allowed.
Delivery charges are non-refundable.
If delivery exceeds 90 minutes, customers may receive a coupon or partial refund.
Payment Reversal Timeline
Card refunds: 5–7 business days
Mobile wallet refunds: 24–48 hours
Cash refunds: Same day with receipt
Food Safety Policy
All ingredients are sourced from approved vendors.
Frozen items are stored below -18°C.
Fresh vegetables are washed and sanitized before preparation.
Cooking oil is replaced every 48 hours.
Meat products are checked daily for freshness.
Staff members must wear gloves and hairnets.

Absence without notice may result in salary deduction.

Customer FAQs
What are your delivery timings?
We deliver from 11:00 AM until 12:00 AM depending on branch timings.
Do you offer free delivery?
Yes, on selected orders above Rs. 1000 within eligible areas.
Are your burgers halal?
Yes, all meat products are 100% halal certified.
Do you host birthday events?
Yes, event bookings are available at selected branches.
Can customers customize orders?
Yes, customers may request ingredient additions or removals.
Do you have vegetarian options?
Yes, several vegetarian burgers, pizzas, and fries are available.
